aircraft._commentFlaps: X-Plane flap_handle_deploy_ratio reports normalized handle travel. These 737 labels map the nine Boeing handle detents across that 0-1 range so raw 0.875 displays as Flaps 30, not 88%.

grades._comment: Provisional 737-family landing bands pending in-sim verification.

telemetry._comment: Uses only the built-in X-Plane Web API telemetry provider. No aircraft-specific dataref or command mapping is active.

meta.notes: Conservative X-Plane test profile for Zibo B737-800X identity and basic aircraft category handling. Approach category D is used because the reference 737-800 Vref range reaches 163 kt. No custom X-Plane datarefs or commands are active.

sources.notes: Documents the Zibo B737-800X project identity. Matching requires the common B737-800X install path or a Zibo-specific identity alias to avoid confusing the Laminar b738.acf with Zibo.
